home.title: What would you like to study?
home.lead: Search programs at universities around the world, compare costs and requirements, and get free advice from a GEC counsellor.
home.dest_title: Where would you like to go?
home.dest_lead: Costs, work rights and intakes for each country.
home.how_title: From first question to first day on campus
home.how_lead: One counsellor stays with you through every step.
home.step_search_text: Search programs and scholarships, compare costs and save a shortlist.
home.step_consult_text: A free consultation to check your profile and choose the right universities.
home.step_apply_text: We prepare your documents and submit your applications, and track every offer.
home.step_visa_text: Visa preparation, accommodation and pre-departure briefing.
home.featured_lead: Popular choices from our partner universities.
home.schol_lead: Funding you may be eligible for — check the criteria in seconds.
home.cta_text: Tell us your goals and budget; a counsellor will suggest options that fit you.

finder.title: Find a program
finder.lead: Search programs by country, subject, degree, budget and English score.
finder.english_hint: Shows programs whose published minimum you meet.
finder.none_text: Try fewer filters — or ask a counsellor, we may know options not listed yet.
finder.disclaimer: Fees, requirements and dates come from our catalogue and can change. Your counsellor confirms them with the university before you apply.

program.not_published: Not published yet — your counsellor will confirm.
program.verify_note: Information may change; always confirmed with the university before applying.
program.next_step_text: A counsellor checks your eligibility and helps you apply — free.
program.whatsapp_text: Hello GEC, I'm interested in {name} at {uni}.

unis.title: Universities
unis.lead: Universities we work with, their programs, fees and requirements.
unis.interested_text: We can check your eligibility and prepare your application.

schol.title: Scholarships
schol.lead: Scholarships and funding for international students.
schol.none_text: Funding changes often — a counsellor can tell you what's available for your profile.
schol.verdict_likely: You appear to meet the listed criteria.
schol.verdict_possible: You may be eligible — some criteria need a closer look.
schol.verdict_unlikely: You don't appear to meet all listed criteria.
schol.c_degree_no: Not offered for this degree level
schol.c_gpa_low: Your grades are below the published minimum
schol.check_disclaimer: This is an indication only, based on the criteria we list. The provider makes the decision.
schol.apply_help_text: We'll check your fit and prepare a strong application.
schol.disclaimer: Scholarship details change often; always check the official source.

dest.title: Study destinations
dest.lead: Compare countries by cost, work rights after study and intakes.
dest.disclaimer: Costs are typical ranges for planning and change every year. Immigration rules change too — they are not legal advice.

compare.title: Compare programs
compare.lead: Up to four programs side by side.
compare.empty_text: Use the scale button on any program to add it here.
compare.disclaimer: Living costs are estimates for the destination. Fees and requirements must be confirmed with each university.

shortlist.title: My shortlist
shortlist.lead_visitor: Programs, universities and scholarships you saved on this device.
shortlist.lead_student: Saved programs, universities and scholarships — your counsellor sees them too.
shortlist.empty_text: Tap the bookmark on a program, university or scholarship to keep it here.
shortlist.sign_in_hint: Create a free account to keep your shortlist and share it with your counsellor.
shortlist.cta_title: Ready to talk about your shortlist?
shortlist.cta_text: A counsellor can check which options fit your profile best.
shortlist.empty_staff_text: Save programs from the Matches tab, or the student saves them on the website.

calc.title: Study cost calculator
calc.lead: Estimate a year of study — tuition, housing, food, transport, insurance, visa and flights — and compare destinations.
calc.disclaimer: Estimates based on typical costs and exchange rates; actual costs depend on the university, city and lifestyle.
calc.cta_text: Your counsellor can prepare one for the programs on your shortlist.
calc.not_sent: Estimate saved, but the e-mail could not be sent (e-mail not connected).
calc.mail_body: Hello {name}, {counsellor} prepared a cost estimate for your study plans. Open it with the button below.

search.none_text: Try different words, or ask a counsellor.
search.hint: Type a subject, university, country or scholarship.

match.disclaimer: Matches compare your profile with published requirements. They are guidance, not a prediction or a guarantee of admission.
match.staff_note: Matches use the student's profile and the catalogue. Missing catalogue data is flagged, never assumed.
match.none_text: Add the student's grades, English test and study goals to see matching programs.
match.r_gpa_close: Grades are just below the published minimum
match.r_gpa_below: Grades are below the published minimum
match.r_gpa_unpublished: Academic minimum not published — verify with the university
match.r_english_band: Overall score is fine, but no band may be below {band}
match.r_english_missing: Add an English test score to check eligibility
match.r_english_unpublished: English requirement not published — verify with the university
match.r_budget_within: Within budget (≈ {cost} a year incl. living costs)
match.r_budget_missing: Add a yearly budget to compare costs

catalog.per_year: Per year, in the selected currency.
catalog.slug_hint: Web address; filled automatically from the English name.
catalog.cost_profile_hint: Yearly costs for the calculator, e.g. {"accommodation": 9000, "food": 3500, "transport": 900, "insurance": 1500, "visa": 500, "flights": 1200, "other": 1500}
catalog.regions_hint: Optional regions shown on the page: [{"name_en": "California", "name_ar": "كاليفورنيا", "overview_en": "…", "tuition": "$28k–65k"}]
catalog.ranking_source_hint: e.g. QS 2026, THE 2026, US News — shown with the ranking.
catalog.gpa_pct_hint: As a percentage: 3.0 on a 4.0 scale is 75.
catalog.nationalities_hint: ISO country codes, one per line (e.g. JO, SA). Leave empty for any nationality.
catalog.rates_lead: Exchange rates used to compare tuition with budgets in USD. They are estimates — update them regularly.

universities.empty_text: Add universities or import them from CSV.
